description: This file defines a Java interface 'ModifyCommandResponseAdapter' that extends a generic 'Adapter' for command responses, providing default behavior related to criteria and actions for modifying command responses within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ModifyCommandResponseAdapter
classes.description: A Java interface serving as a mixin for adapters that handle modify command responses, providing default implementations for criteria, actions, and response identification.

methods.name: getCriteria
methods.description: Returns a set containing the criterion 'COMMANDS' indicating the relevant topic criterion for modify command responses.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns a set containing actions 'CREATE', 'MODIFY', and 'DELETE' indicating the types of actions this adapter responds to.

methods.name: isForResponses
methods.description: Indicates that this adapter is specifically for handling responses by returning true.
